SCREEN.s00-landing.purpose.en:
Your story. Your choice. Your control.

Today you will begin creating your first Atlas Record—a private record of the health experiences you choose to share.

Your Atlas Record helps you organize your experiences over time so you can better understand changes, identify recurring patterns, and reflect on your health journey.
SCREEN.s00-landing.purpose.luo:
Sigandini. Yieroni. Teloni.

Kawuono ibichako chweyo Atlas Record mari mokwongo—kare ma en mari kende mar gik moko mag ngima ma iyiero mondo inyis.

Atlas Record mari konyi mondo ipar gik moko ma otimoreni e kinde mang'eny mondo inyal winjo maber kaka gik moko olokore, mondo inyal neno gik ma timorega pile, kendo mondo inyal paro matut e wi wuoth mari mar ngima.
SCREEN.s00-landing.purpose.kik:
Ng'ano yaku. Mũthuurĩre waku. Ũtongoria waku.

Ũmũthĩ nĩũkambĩrĩria kũthondeka Rekodi yaku ya mbere ya Atlas—rekodi ya wĩyathi ya maũndũ ma ũgima wa mwĩrĩ marĩa ũgũthuura kũruta.

Rekodi yaku ya Atlas nĩĩgũteithia kũthondeka maũndũ maku ma ũgima wa mwĩrĩ ihinda rĩthee nĩguo ũmenye wega macenjia, ũmenye mĩhianĩre ĩrĩa ĩcokaga, na ũcũranĩrie ũrĩa ũgima waku ũthiaga.

SCREEN.s01-consent.purpose.en: Before you begin, please review how Womb Atlas uses the information you choose to share. Participation is voluntary, and you may pause or withdraw according to the choices explained here.
SCREEN.s01-consent.purpose.luo: Ka pok ichako, konyuru mondo inon kaka Womb Atlas tiyo gi weche ma iyiero mondo inyis. Bedo e ranyisi en gima iyiero, kendo inyalo chungo kata golo lweteni kaluwore gi yiero ma oler ka.
SCREEN.s01-consent.purpose.kik: Mbere ya kũambĩrĩria, ndũkanehere kũrora ũrĩa Womb Atlas ĩhũthagĩra ũhoro ũrĩa ũgũthuura kũruta. Kũrũmĩrĩra nĩ kwa wĩyathi, na no ũtũũre kana ũreke kũrũmĩrĩra kũringana na mĩthuurĩre ĩrĩa ĩtaarĩirio haha.

SCREEN.s02-how-womb-atlas-works.name.kik: Ũrĩa Ũrori waku wa mbere ũrutaga wĩra.

SCREEN.s02-how-womb-atlas-works.purpose.en:
Womb Atlas observes and helps you understand your health journey. It does not diagnose conditions or replace medical care. Your observations are preserved as an Atlas Record, helping you remember, reflect on, and understand your patterns over time. You can skip any question.

Your answers are organized into an Atlas Record that helps you see your experiences together rather than as isolated symptoms.

After completion, Womb Atlas may provide a reflection that summarizes what you shared, highlights possible patterns, and offers education without diagnosing a condition.

Every observation you share become part of the living observatory, advancing women's health for everyone.
SCREEN.s02-how-womb-atlas-works.purpose.luo:
Womb Atlas nono kendo konyi mondo iwinj wuoth mari mar ngima. Ok onyis ni in gi tuwo moro kata ok ochung' kar yado mar daktari. Gik ma inono keti e Atlas Record, konyi mondo ipar, ipar matut, kendo iwinj kaka gik moko timorega pile e kinde mang'eny. Inyalo weyo penjo moro amora.

Dwokoni oket e Atlas Record ma konyi mondo inen gik moko ma otimoreni ka gin kanyachiel kar neno kaka tuoche moko kende kende.

Bang' ka isechopo giko, Womb Atlas nyalo chiwo paro matut ma oting'o gima inyiso, nyiso gik ma nyalo bedo ni timorega pile, kendo chiwo puonj ma ok onyis ni in gi tuwo moro.

Nono moro amora ma inyiso bedo achiel kuom kar nono ma siko, konyo mondo ngima mon odhi nyime ne ji duto.
SCREEN.s02-how-womb-atlas-works.purpose.kik:
Womb Atlas nĩĩroraga na ĩgũteithia kũmenya ũrĩa ũgima waku ũthiaga. Ndĩtũmagĩra mĩrimũ kana kũrĩhĩria ũrigitani. Maũndũ marĩa ũrora nĩmathikagĩrĩrio ta Rekodi ya Atlas, makĩgũteithia kũririkana, kũcũranĩria, na kũmenya mĩhianĩre yaku ihinda rĩthee. No ũreke kũcokia kĩũria o na kĩrĩkũ.

Macokio maku nĩmathondekagĩrĩrio Rekodi-inĩ ya Atlas ĩrĩa ĩgũteithia kũona maũndũ maku hamwe handũ ha ta iratĩ cia mũrimũ irĩ o imwe.

Thutha wa kũrĩkia, Womb Atlas no ĩkũhe ũcũranĩria ũrĩa ũgũcũrania maũndũ marĩa ũrutire, ũgũtũma mĩhianĩre ĩrĩa ĩngĩoneka ĩoneke wega, na ĩgũkũhe ũrutani itarĩ ĩgũtũma mũrimũ.

Ũrori o wothe ũrĩa ũruta nĩũtuĩkaga kĩcunjĩ kĩa kĩhũngũri kĩrĩa kĩrĩ muoyo, gĩkĩambĩrĩria ũgima wa mwĩrĩ wa atumia kũrĩ andũ othe.

SCREEN.s03-quick-safety-check.purpose.en: This is a quick safety check. Womb Atlas is not an emergency sercive and does not provide a diagnosis.
SCREEN.s03-quick-safety-check.purpose.luo: Mano en nono mar ritruok mapiyo. Womb Atlas ok en kony mar kiny kiny kendo ok onyis ni in gi tuwo moro.
SCREEN.s03-quick-safety-check.purpose.kik: Ũyũ nĩ ũthuthuria mũhũthũ wa ũgitĩri. Womb Atlas ti thabari ya huthu na ndĩtũmagĩra mũrimũ.

SCREEN.s04-safety-alert.purpose.en:
You selected one or more experiences that can sometimes need timely medical attention.

Consider contacting an appropriate healthcare service promptly. If symptoms feel severe, rapidly worsening, or immediately dangerous, seek local emergency care.

Womb Atlas cannot assess emergencies or tell you whether a condition is present.

You may continue your First Observation after reviewing this guidance.
SCREEN.s04-safety-alert.purpose.luo:
Iseyiero gik moko achiel kata mang'eny ma nyalo dwaro kony mar daktari mapiyo.

Par mondo ikwany daktari mapiyo. Ka tuoche winjore ni tek, ka gichako marach mapiyo, kata ka gin marach mapiyo, dwar kony mar kiny kiny e alwora.

Womb Atlas ok nyal neno gik mar kiny kiny kata nyisi ni in gi tuwo moro.

Inyalo siko gi nono mari mokwongo bang' ka isenono puonjni.
SCREEN.s04-safety-alert.purpose.kik:
Nĩwathuurire maũndũ mamwe kana maingĩ marĩa hĩndĩ imwe mangĩbatara ũrigitani wa huthu.

Cũrania kũgweta thabari ya ũrigitani ĩrĩa yagĩrĩire na ihenya. Angĩkorũo iratĩ cia mũrimũ nĩ njũru mũno, ikĩĩgereka na ihenya, kana irĩ cia kũhĩngĩca huthu, rora thabari ya huthu ya kũrĩa ũrĩ.

Womb Atlas ndĩngĩhota kũthuthuria maũndũ ma huthu kana kũkũĩra kana mũrimũ nĩ ũrĩ ho.

No ũthiĩ na mbere na Ũrori waku wa mbere thutha wa kũrora ũtaaro ũyũ.

SCREEN.s05-context-intro.name.luo: Gik moko ma omoni gin gima duong'.
SCREEN.s05-context-intro.name.kik: Ũhoro waku wa kũrĩa ũrĩ nĩ wa bata.

SCREEN.s05-context-intro.purpose.en:
Your experiences do not happen in isolation. Age, life stage, hormonal context, pregnancy history, language, culture and access to care may shape how symptoms are experienced and understood.

Context helps Womb Atlas organize observations more accurately and avoid treating every participant as though their circumstances are the same.
SCREEN.s05-context-intro.purpose.luo:
Gik moko ma otimoreni ok timore kende kende. Higa, kaka ngima odhi, kaka homon ochung', kaka ich osebedo, dhok, kido, kod yudo kony mar daktari nyalo chweyo kaka tuoche winjore kendo kaka ji winjo.

Gik moko ma omoni konyo Womb Atlas mondo oket gik ma inono e yo makare kendo mondo kik otim ne ng'ato ka ng'ato kaka gima gik moko duto gin mana achiel.
SCREEN.s05-context-intro.purpose.kik:
Maũndũ maku matiĩkaga marĩ o make. Mĩaka, mĩthiĩre ya ũtũũro, ũhoro wa homoni, ũhoro wa kũmĩta, rũthiomi, mũtũũrĩre na ũhoti wa kũgĩa na ũrigitani no ĩcenjie ũrĩa iratĩ cia mũrimũ cionekaga na ikamenyeka.

Ũhoro wa kũrĩa ũrĩ nĩũteithagia Womb Atlas kũthondeka maũndũ marĩa ĩrora na ũũgĩ mũingĩ na kũrega kũrigitaga mũrũmĩrĩri o wothe ta maũndũ make marĩ o mamwe.

SCREEN.s06-age.purpose.en: Age can shape life stage, healthcare access, and how symptoms are experienced. You may choose 'Prefer not to say.'
SCREEN.s06-age.purpose.luo: Higa nyalo chweyo kaka ngima odhi, yudo kony mar daktari, kendo kaka tuoche winjore. Inyalo yiero ni 'Ok adwar nyiso.'
SCREEN.s06-age.purpose.kik: Mĩaka no ĩcenjie mĩthiĩre ya ũtũũro, ũhoti wa kũgĩa na ũrigitani, na ũrĩa iratĩ cia mũrimũ cionekaga. No ũthuure 'Ndĩrenda kũgweta.'

SCREEN.s07-reproductive-state.purpose.en: Life stages can change over time. Choose the option that feels closest to your current experience.
SCREEN.s07-reproductive-state.purpose.luo: Kaka ngima odhi nyalo lokore e kinde mang'eny. Yier gima winjore ni ochiegni gi gima itimo sani.
SCREEN.s07-reproductive-state.purpose.kik: Mĩthiĩre ya ũtũũro no ĩcenjage ihinda rĩthee. Thuura mũthuurĩre ũrĩa ũkũhĩrĩirie maũndũ maku ma rĩu.

SCREEN.s08-hormonal-contraception.purpos.en: Hormonal contraception can change bleeding patterns and other body signals. This question does not assume why you use it.
SCREEN.s08-hormonal-contraception.purpos.luo: Yado mar homon mar golo nywol nyalo loko kaka remo wuok kendo ranyisi moko mag del. Penjoni ok par ni ang'o momiyo itiyo kode.
SCREEN.s08-hormonal-contraception.purpos.kik: Kũhinga kũmĩta na homoni no gũcenjie mĩhianĩre ya kũrũithia na iratĩ ingĩ cia mwĩrĩ. Kĩũria kĩu gĩtirĩ gĩkũhũthĩra nĩkĩ ũgĩhũthagĩra.

SCREEN.s09-context-transition.name.en: Your language, culture and location matter
SCREEN.s09-context-transition.name.luo: Dhok mari, kido mari, kod kama idakie gin gima duong'.
SCREEN.s09-context-transition.name.kik: Rũthiomi rwaku, mũtũũrĩre waku na kũrĩa ũrĩ nĩ cia bata.

SCREEN.s09-context-transition.purpose.en:
Language, culture, place and migration can shape how health experiences are described, understood, and supported.

Womb Atlas does not use cultural identity to decide what your body is like or to make deterministic assumptions about risk.

You may select more than one background, use self-description where available, or choose 'Prefer not to say.'
SCREEN.s09-context-transition.purpose.luo:
Dhok, kido, kama idakie, kod wuoth nyalo chweyo kaka gik moko mag ngima oler, owinjore, kendo oyud kony.

Womb Atlas ok ti gi kido mar oganda mondo oyier ni delni chalo nade kata mondo otim paro ma ok nyal lokore e wi ketho.

Inyalo yiero gik moko mang'eny, ti gi gima inyalo nyiso iwuon ka en, kata yiero ni 'Ok adwar nyiso.'
SCREEN.s09-context-transition.purpose.kik:
Rũthiomi, mũtũũrĩre, kũrĩa mũndũ arĩ na kũhũthũka no ĩcenjie ũrĩa maũndũ ma ũgima wa mwĩrĩ mataaragĩrio, makamenyeka, na makĩgĩrĩrĩrio.

Womb Atlas ndĩhũthagĩra ũmenyi wa mũtũũrĩre kũtua ũrĩa mwĩrĩ waku ũrĩ kana kũhũthĩra maũndũ ma kũmenya ũrĩa ũngĩkorũo ũrĩ ũgwati-inĩ.

No ũthuure mĩhianĩre mĩingĩ, ũhũthĩre kwĩtaarĩria we mwene kũrĩa kũngĩhoteka, kana ũthuure 'Ndĩrenda kũgweta.'

SCREEN.s10-cultural-background.purpose.en: These categories may not describe everyone perfectly. Select all that fit, self-describe where available, or choose 'Prefer not to say.'
SCREEN.s10-cultural-background.purpose.kik: Ciĩga ici no nginya itigĩe kũhũthĩra andũ othe wega. Thuurana ciothe iria ciagĩrĩire, wĩjĩandĩkĩre kũrĩa kũngĩhoteka, kana ũthuure 'Ndĩrenda kũgweta.'
SCREEN.s10-cultural-background.purpose.luo: Wechego nyalo bedo ni ok gin kare ne ng'ato ka ng'ato. Yier duto ma owinjore, konyuru ka inyalo konyori gi weche mari, kata yier 'Ok adwar wacho.'

SCREEN.s11-current-country.purpose.en: Your current country helps Womb Atlas understand healthcare and language context. It does not define your identity.
SCREEN.s11-current-country.purpose.kik: Bũrũri waku wa rĩu ũteithagia Womb Atlas kũmenya ũrĩa ũthathaiya wa mĩrimũ na rũthiomi rũhũthĩragwo. Ndũrĩo ũrĩ mũndũ ũrĩa ũrĩ.
SCREEN.s11-current-country.purpose.luo: Piny ma inie sani konyo Womb Atlas mondo ong'e kaka tich lamo osiep kod dhok otimoree. Ok en gima nyiso ni in ng'ato mane.

SCREEN.s12-birth-country.purpose.en: This may help describe migration and care continuity. You may choose not to answer.
SCREEN.s12-birth-country.purpose.kik: Ũndũ ũyũ no ũteithie kũgweta ũrĩa mũndũ aathamire na ũrĩa ũthathaiya wa mĩrimũ ũthiaga na mbere. No ũthuure kũrĩgia kũcokia.
SCREEN.s12-birth-country.purpose.luo: Mano nyalo konyo mondo ong'e kaka ji owuotho kendo kaka ginyalo yudo konyruok. Inyalo yiero ni ok idwar dwoko.

SCREEN.s13-preferred-language.purpose.en: This may differ from the language you use every day.
SCREEN.s13-preferred-language.purpose.kik: Rũthiomi rũrũ no rũkorwo rũtarĩ rũrĩa ũhũthagĩra o mũthenya.
SCREEN.s13-preferred-language.purpose.luo: Mano nyalo bedo ni opogore gi dhok ma itiyogo pile ka pile.

SCREEN.s14-family-history.purpose.en: Select what you know. It is okay to choose 'I am not sure' or 'Prefer not to say.'
SCREEN.s14-family-history.purpose.kik: Thuurana ũrĩa ũũĩ. Nĩ wega gũthuura 'Ndĩ mũũgĩ' kana 'Ndĩrenda kũgweta.'
SCREEN.s14-family-history.purpose.luo: Yier gima ing'eyo. Ok en ketho ka iyiero 'Ok ang'eyo' kata 'Ok adwar wacho.'

SCREEN.s16-reproductive-transition.name.en: Your history may be different from someone else's
SCREEN.s16-reproductive-transition.name.kik: Mĩaka yaku ya kũgũrũka no ĩkorwo ĩtarĩ ta ya mũndũ ũngĩ
SCREEN.s16-reproductive-transition.name.luo: Mbaka mari nyalo pogore gi mar ng'at machielo

SCREEN.s16-reproductive-transition.purpo.en:
Some people have been pregnant, some have not, and some prefer not to share. The questions that follow will adapt to your answer.

Having never been pregnant will not skip the rest of your health observation.
SCREEN.s16-reproductive-transition.purpo.kik:
Andũ amwe nĩ mahingĩte nda, angĩ matirahingĩte, na angĩ makenda kũrĩgia kũgweta. Ciũria iria irũmĩrĩire nĩ ikũgarũrũka kũringana na ũrĩa ũkũcokia.

Kũrĩgia kũhinga nda gũtirĩgĩrĩria ũthathaiya waku wa mĩrimũ ũrĩa ũngĩ.
SCREEN.s16-reproductive-transition.purpo.luo:
Jomoko osetuwo, jomoko pok otuwo, kendo jomoko ok dwar wacho. Penjo ma biro luwo biro lokore kaluwore gi dwokoni.

Ka pok otuwo ok bi weyo nonro mar osiep duto.

SCREEN.s21-bleeding-patterns.purpose.en:
The next questions ask about bleeding you experience now or have experienced recently. This may include regular cycles, irregular bleeding, spotting, postpartum bleeding, bleeding after menopause, or bleeding influenced by treatment.

Choose 'Not applicable,' 'I am not sure,' or 'Prefer not to say' where available.
SCREEN.s21-bleeding-patterns.purpose.kik:
Ciũria iria irũmĩrĩire nĩ iroria igũrũ rĩa thakame ĩrĩa ĩkũhũmagĩra rĩu kana ĩrĩa ĩkũhũmĩte narĩu. Ũndũ ũyũ no ũkorwo ũrĩ thakame ya mĩthenya ya mĩgwanja, thakame ĩtarĩ ya mĩthenya ya mĩgwanja, thakame nini, thakame ya thutha wa kũhĩtũka, thakame ya thutha wa kũrĩgia kũhũma mĩthenya ya mĩgwanja, kana thakame ĩrĩa ĩgarũrũkĩtio nĩ ũthathaiya wa mĩrimũ.

Thuurana 'Ndĩrĩ na ũguni,' 'Ndĩ mũũgĩ,' kana 'Ndĩrenda kũgweta' kũrĩa kũngĩhoteka.
SCREEN.s21-bleeding-patterns.purpose.luo:
Penjo ma biro luwo biro penjo kuom remo ma inyalo yudo sani kata ma iseyudo nyaka sani. Mano nyalo chopo remo ma biro pile, remo ma ok bi pile, remo matin, remo bang' nyuol, remo bang' ka kiko osechopo, kata remo ma konyruok osiko. 

Yier 'Ok owinjore,' 'Ok ang'eyo,' kata 'Ok adwar wacho' ka inyalo.

SCREEN.s29-pain-and-discomfort.purpose.en:
The next questions ask about pain, pressure, aching, cramping or discomfort. These experiences may be constant, occasional, linked to bleeding, or unrelated to a cycle.

If you do not experience pain or discomfort, your path will adapt.
SCREEN.s29-pain-and-discomfort.purpose.luo:
Penjo ma biro biro kwayo e wi lit, kido, rem, lit ma chokore e i kata onge yom. Magi ma inyalo winjo nyalo bedo ma ok chokore, kinde ka kinde, nyalo bedo ka oriwore gi remo, kata ma onge kaka oriwore gi ndalo mag dhiang'.

Ka ok iwinjo lit kata onge yom, yo mari biro lokore.
SCREEN.s29-pain-and-discomfort.purpose.kik:
Ciuria iria igũkora ciũragia igũhũthĩra ruo, kũhinyĩrĩrĩka, kũrũmĩka, kũnyinyirika kana kũmaka mwĩrĩ. Maũndũ maya no marĩ maingĩ hĩndĩ ciothe, hĩndĩ na hĩndĩ, marĩ na ũgima na kũhũra thakame, kana matarĩ na ũgima na mĩhũro ya mweri.

Angĩkorwo ndũhũthĩra ruo kana kũmaka mwĩrĩ, njĩra yaku nĩgũcenjia.

SCREEN.s33-pain-duration.purpose.luo: Ka ng’ato owinjo lit kata ok owinjo maber, to kinde mang’eny owinjo lit kuom kinde maromo nade?
SCREEN.s33-pain-duration.purpose.kik: Rĩrĩa ruo kana thĩĩna wa mwĩrĩ woka, nĩ ihinda rĩigana ũikaraga?

SCREEN.s34-pain-predictability.purpose.luo: Ere kaka inyalo ng’eyo kinde ma ibiro winjoe lit kata bedo gi paro ma ok kare?
SCREEN.s34-pain-predictability.purpose.kik: Nĩ ruo rũrĩkũ rwa ngoro kana nĩ ruo rũrĩkũ rwa ngoro rwatũmaga tũkorũo na nganja?

SCREEN.s39-cycles-and-body-rhythms.purpo.en:
The next questions ask about cycles, bleeding rhythms and hormonal changes. Some questions will adapt if you do not currently have regular cycles.

You can choose 'Not applicable,' 'I am not sure,' or 'Prefer not to say' where available.
SCREEN.s39-cycles-and-body-rhythms.purpo.luo:
Penjo ma biro biro kwayo e wi ndalo mag dhiang', kaka remo dhiang'e kod lokruok mag homoni. Moko kuom penjogi biro lokore ka ok in gi ndalo mag dhiang' ma dhi nyime kare.

Inyalo yiero 'Ok en gima oriwore koda,' 'Ok ang'eyo,' kata 'Ok adwar wacho' ka en kanyo.
SCREEN.s39-cycles-and-body-rhythms.purpo.kik:
Ciuria iria igũkora ciũragia igũhũthĩra mĩhũro ya mweri, mĩhũro ya thakame ĩrĩa ĩhũragia na macenjia ma homoni. Ciuria imwe nĩgũcenjia angĩkorwo rĩu ndũrĩ na mĩhũro ya mweri ĩrĩa ĩthiaga na mũtaratara.

No ũthuurage 'Ndĩrĩ na ũgima nayo,' 'Ndĩrĩ na ma,' kana 'Ndĩrenda kũgweta' kũrĩa kũngĩkorwo.

SCREEN.s46-daily-life-and-impact.name.luo: Kaka ranyisi chando ngima mar pile ka pile
SCREEN.s46-daily-life-and-impact.name.kik: Ũrĩa ciama ihutagia mũtũũrĩre wa o mũthenya

SCREEN.s46-daily-life-and-impact.purpose.en:
The next questions ask how symptoms affect your energy, sleep, work or school, caregiving, movement and daily routines. There is no right level of impact.

You can choose 'None,' 'Not applicable,' or 'Prefer not to say' where available.
SCREEN.s46-daily-life-and-impact.purpose.luo:
Penjo ma biro biro kwayo kaka gima iwinjo chando teko mari, nindo mari, tich kata skul, rito jomoko, dhi mari kod timbe mag pile ka pile. Onge kaka owinjore mar chando.

Inyalo yiero 'Onge,' 'Ok en gima oriwore koda,' kata 'Ok adwar wacho' ka en kanyo.
SCREEN.s46-daily-life-and-impact.purpose.kik:
Ciuria iria igũkora ciũragia ũrĩa maũndũ marĩa ũhũthĩra macenjagia hinya waku, toro, wĩra kana cukuru, kũmenyerera andũ angĩ, kũgũtha mwĩrĩ na maũndũ marĩa ũkagĩrĩria o mũthenya. Gũtirĩ ũrĩa kũngĩkorwo kũrĩ kũgaa mũno ũrĩa maũndũ macio magũthĩĩte.

No ũthuurage 'Gũtirĩ,' 'Ndĩrĩ na ũgima nayo,' kana 'Ndĩrenda kũgweta' kũrĩa kũngĩkorwo.

SCREEN.s57-care-and-support.name.en: Your experiences seeking care and support

SCREEN.reproductive-history-intro.purpos.luo:
Penjo moluwo biro penjo e wi gima ne otimore e wach nyuol. Magi gin gik ma ng'ato ka ng'ato nigi, kendo ok penjo duto biro chopo ne ng'ato ka ng'ato.

Inyalo yiero 'Ok adwar wacho' kama inyalo yiero. Dwaro mari ok bi nyiso ni in ng'at mar nengo maromo, kata ni in ng'at mane, kata ni inyalo dhi nyime.
SCREEN.reproductive-history-intro.purpos.kik:
Ciũria iria igũka nĩ igũrũ rĩa maũndũ marĩa wĩkĩte na ũhoro wa kũgĩa ciana. Maũndũ maya nĩ maku mwene, na ti ciũria ciothe irĩkĩrĩirie mũndũ wothe.

Ũngĩĩthuurĩra 'Ndikwenda kũgweta' kũrĩa kũngĩoneka. Macokio maku matirĩĩkĩrĩria ũrĩa ũrĩ, kana ũrĩa ũrĩĩĩtagwo, kana ũrĩa ũngĩtĩkĩrĩka kũrũmĩrĩra.
SCREEN.reproductive-history-intro.purpos.en:
The next questions ask about reproductive experiences. These experiences are personal, and not every question will apply to everyone.

You may choose 'Prefer not to say' where available. Your answers do not determine your worth, identity or eligibility to continue.
